overview: In the afternoon, while the Shrew went on without you, you left the messenger's half-line empty and wrote the women's sentence under it. A twelvemonth and a day. The words he would have said are still not there. Foul paper, not a finished act.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Wrote the sentence around the blank and did not fill the blank.

key_provisions.text: an afternoon not at the play

assets.name: Love's Labour's Lost
assets.disposition: Wrote a twelvemonth and a day

summary: Wrote a twelvemonth and a day
